import copy
import unittest

from solution import sort_assets


class SortAssetsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_ascending_and_descending(self):
        items = [{"id": "a", "price": 3}, {"id": "b", "price": 1}, {"id": "c", "price": 2}]
        self.assertEqual([x["id"] for x in sort_assets(items, "price")], ["b", "c", "a"])
        self.assertEqual([x["id"] for x in sort_assets(items, "price", True)], ["a", "c", "b"])

    def test_sort_is_stable_in_both_directions(self):
        items = [{"id": "first", "rank": 1}, {"id": "second", "rank": 1}, {"id": "third", "rank": 2}]
        self.assertEqual([x["id"] for x in sort_assets(items, "rank")], ["first", "second", "third"])
        self.assertEqual([x["id"] for x in sort_assets(items, "rank", True)], ["third", "first", "second"])

    def test_deep_copy_and_no_input_mutation(self):
        items = [
            {"rank": 2, "nested": {"values": [1]}},
            {"rank": 1, "nested": {"values": [2]}},
        ]
        before = copy.deepcopy(items)
        result = sort_assets(items, "rank")
        self.assertEqual(items, before)
        self.assertIsNot(result, items)
        result[0]["nested"]["values"].append(99)
        self.assertEqual(items, before)

    def test_empty_list(self):
        items = []
        result = sort_assets(items, "field")
        self.assertEqual(result, [])
        self.assertIsNot(result, items)

    def test_validation(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            sort_assets((), "x")
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            sort_assets([], 1)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            sort_assets([], "")
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            sort_assets([], "x", 1)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            sort_assets([[]], "x")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            sort_assets([{"other": 1}], "x")

    def test_incomparable_values_raise_value_error_without_mutation(self):
        items = [{"x": 1, "nested": []}, {"x": "one", "nested": []}]
        before = copy.deepcopy(items)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            sort_assets(items, "x")
        self.assertEqual(items, before)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
